_authority: Pinned display-name mapping for the six confluence influences (v1 scope, per whispers08 plan + user confirmation). Tag suffixes are the RePoE spawn_weights[].tag suffixes (e.g. claw_basilisk) AND the item_classes.json influence_tags vocabulary. Suffixes are data-derived (mods.json/item_classes.json); display names are the community-standard influence names for those suffixes. Eldritch / Delve / Essence / Fossil / Synthesis / Scourge / Crucible / Veiled pseudo-influences are deliberately OUT of v1 scope; they are never inferred.

_evidence.suffix_tag_shape: repoe/mods.json spawn_weights[].tag = '<itemclass_tag>_<suffix>' with weight>0 (e.g. claw_basilisk weight 200 on AddedLightningDamagePerIntelligenceInfluence1)
_evidence.class_tag_shape: repoe/item_classes.json item_classes[].influence_tags = per-class list of the same tags (e.g. Claw -> [claw_crusader, claw_elder, claw_basilisk, claw_eyrie, claw_shaper, claw_adjudicator])
